title: Radiologist
description: Company Description The hiring organization is a healthcare provider committed to delivering high-quality diagnostic and clinical services to the local community in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The facility is focused on expanding access to advanced medical imaging and radiology services to support accurate diagnosis and treatment. Team members collaborate across disciplines to provide safe, patient-centered care grounded in evidence-based practices. The organization values professional growth, ethical standards, and continuous improvement in clinical outcomes. Radiology professionals joining the team can expect a supportive environment that encourages learning and excellence in practice. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Radiologist role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Radiologist will interpret a wide range of diagnostic imaging studies, such as X-rays, CT scans, MRI, ultrasound, and mammography, and provide clear, timely reports to referring clinicians. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing patient histories, selecting appropriate imaging protocols, ensuring image quality, and correlating imaging findings with clinical information. The Radiologist will participate in multidisciplinary discussions, communicate results and recommendations to healthcare teams, and contribute to patient counseling when needed. Additional tasks may include supervising radiologic technologists, supporting quality assurance initiatives, adhering to radiation safety standards, and engaging in continuing education to maintain up-to-date clinical knowledge. Qualifications Strong foundation in Medicine, including comprehensive clinical knowledge and patient-centered care. Proficiency in Radiology and Medical Imaging, with experience interpreting common modalities (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound). Experience or training in Nuclear Medicine, including safe use of radiopharmaceuticals and interpretation of functional imaging. Competence in Mammography, with skills in screening, diagnostic imaging, and appropriate follow-up recommendations. Recognized medical degree and completed residency or specialist training in Radiology (or equivalent credential). Valid medical license or eligibility for licensure in Ethiopia, and compliance with local regulatory requirements. Attention to detail, strong analytical and diagnostic skills, and ability to produce clear, concise reports. Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary healthcare teams. Commitment to patient safety, radiation protection principles, and continuous professional development.

title: Pattern Maker
description: Company Description Sunshine Ethiopia Wool Textile is a growing textile manufacturer specializing in wool and related fabric products for local and international markets. The company focuses on quality craftsmanship, reliable production processes, and timely delivery to meet the needs of fashion brands and garment manufacturers. Working with modern machinery and skilled professionals, Sunshine Ethiopia Wool Textile aims to create durable, well-designed textiles that support a range of apparel styles. Team members are encouraged to contribute their technical expertise and creativity to continuously improve products and processes. Role Description The Pattern Maker role at Sunshine Ethiopia Wool Textile is a full-time, on-site position based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Pattern Maker will translate design concepts and technical specifications into accurate patterns for wool and mixed-fabric garments, ensuring proper fit and production efficiency. Daily tasks include drafting and adjusting patterns, collaborating with designers and sample makers, and overseeing fittings to confirm size, shape, and garment structure. The role involves working closely with sewing and cutting teams, using both manual techniques and computer-aided design tools, and maintaining clear documentation for production. The Pattern Maker is expected to support continuous improvement in pattern quality, minimize material waste, and help meet production timelines. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Pattern Making and Pattern Design skills, with the ability to create and modify patterns for various garment types. Candidates should possess practical Sewing and Fitting skills to evaluate prototypes and ensure garments meet design and comfort requirements. Candidates should possess experience with Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools for pattern development, grading, and technical documentation. Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, measurement accuracy, and the ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications. Candidates should possess effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with designers, production staff, and quality control teams. Relevant vocational training or a diploma in textile, fashion design, garment technology, or a related field is beneficial. Prior experience as a Pattern Maker or in garment manufacturing is preferred, especially within wool or heavy fabric production.
